about: Moment pictures the published page leaves out (v22.3, 10-10): one artifact version holds at most 511 files, and v22.3 has 588. These 77 are the rarest moments (rarity.json share of lives under 0.009, and the 16 tribal and magic world moments, whose lives show their world's tarot card instead). Each falls back to its part-of-life picture (pictures.json fallback_order). Bring them back once the code ships as one file (v22.3.1).
